name: interview-kit
description: Mock system design interviews against cited pattern references, plus an extractor for named articles and saved HTML. Enable after an implementation is built.

interface.shortDescription: Mock system design interviews against a cited library
interface.longDescription: Interview one finished implementation using cited system design pattern references and symptom-based probes. Analyze session evidence when available, ask one question at a time, and assess technical understanding. Report seniority observations only when the sources state them. Extract named pattern articles from URLs, saved HTML, or pasted text into a versioned library. Keep the plugin disabled while building the implementation.
capabilities: Mock design interview with source-scoped assessment
Cited concept extraction from a source
defaultPrompt: Interview me on the design in url-shortener/attempt-1.
